name: resolve-pkg
description: Resolve the path of a package regardless of it having an entry point

scripts.pretest: del node_modules/@someprivate/module-test && make-dir node_modules/@someprivate/module-test && cpy 'fixtures/private-module-test/*' node_modules/@someprivate/module-test/ && del node_modules/aliased-pkg && make-dir node_modules/aliased-pkg && cpy 'fixtures/aliased-pkg/*' node_modules/aliased-pkg/ && del node_modules/esm-only-pkg && make-dir node_modules/esm-only-pkg && cpy 'fixtures/esm-only-pkg/*' node_modules/esm-only-pkg/ && del node_modules/nested-package-json-pkg && make-dir node_modules/nested-package-json-pkg/dist && cpy 'fixtures/nested-package-json-pkg/*' node_modules/nested-package-json-pkg/ && cpy 'fixtures/nested-package-json-pkg/dist/*' node_modules/nested-package-json-pkg/dist/
